about: Hand-labelled reference ('golden') slots for code highlighting. Each span names the code slot a run of characters should take. Written by hand from the labelling guide in the memo, not from any highlighter's output.

format.columns: 0-based UTF-16 code units within the line; endColumn is exclusive
format.unlisted: Any character no span covers is foreground.
format.scored: Only non-whitespace characters are scored; a span may include whitespace.
format.sha256: Of the specimen's code as the module exports it, so a changed specimen is detected.

workbench.role: The eighteen workbench specimens: the set the candidates were scored and tuned on.

heldout.source: src/lib/preview/code-samples.ts (CODE_SAMPLES), ten of the twenty-six: python, javascript, typescript, go, rust, java, csharp, ruby, bash, sql
heldout.role: A held-out set: labelled before any candidate was run on it, never used for tuning.
